description: Debug an intermittently failing stdlib test suite: set iteration order breaks the documented ranking tie-break, a helper mutates a dict while iterating it (RuntimeError on larger inputs), and daily_report reads datetime.now() with no injectable clock. Fix the root causes without pinning PYTHONHASHSEED anywhere.

criteria: All three root causes are fixed in pyflaky/ - the ranking follows the documented tie-break deterministically without relying on set order, the merge helper no longer mutates the dict while iterating it, and daily_report accepts an injected clock - with no PYTHONHASHSEED pinning anywhere, the tests, evidence files and gate untouched, and every check in check.py green.
